response.description:
Announcing new capabilities in Azure Logic
Apps that expand hybrid integration through a rich set of connectors. The following connectors are now generally available: Confluent Kafka connector: Connect Logic Apps to
Confluent Cloud for event streaming and real-time data processing. XML – Parse and Compose operations: Easily
handle complex XML operations, bridging modern workflows with legacy systems
and enabling BizTalk migrations. Inline Code operations (C#, PowerShell,
JavaScript): Execute inline code for advanced logic, data manipulation, and
integration flexibility. RabbitMQ connector: Integrate with RabbitMQ for
reliable message queuing across distributed systems. Ideal for on-premises
scenarios. These enhancements strengthen Azure Logic Apps as the
foundation for enterprise-grade, event-driven workflows, bridging on-premises, cloud, and industry-specific systems with
ease.
response.title: Generally Available: New Hybrid Integration Connectors for Azure Logic Apps
